scriptWithTimestamps:
00:00:00:00 - 00:00:02:21
Once you have the data,
you can take it further.

00:00:02:21 - 00:00:06:17
For instance, now you can use it to build
a tiered hashtag strategy.

00:00:06:23 - 00:00:10:11
First, use the data to map
the hashtag landscape search results

00:00:10:11 - 00:00:14:16
by post count and split them into high
volume, mid volume, and niche hashtags.

00:00:15:03 - 00:00:18:03
The broad hashtags
put you in front of large audiences.

00:00:18:04 - 00:00:21:04
Mid volume ones
give a realistic shot at the top posts.

00:00:21:04 - 00:00:24:23
Grid and niche hashtags
connect you to highly engaged communities.

00:00:25:05 - 00:00:28:04
No matter whether you're planning content
or researching a topic,

00:00:28:04 - 00:00:32:01
this approach will give you a clear,
layered view of reach and opportunity.

00:00:32:19 - 00:00:35:13
Second, uncover connections and overlaps.

00:00:35:13 - 00:00:36:15
Co-occurrence data

00:00:36:15 - 00:00:40:10
shows which hashtags, communities,
or content clusters intersect.

00:00:40:16 - 00:00:44:12
If hashtag Pilates frequently appears
with hashtag mindful movement

00:00:44:19 - 00:00:47:13
that tells you there's a meaningful
audience overlap,

00:00:47:13 - 00:00:51:13
you can use this insight to discover
adjacent topics or expand your reach.

00:00:52:05 - 00:00:54:02
Third, track trends over time.

00:00:54:02 - 00:00:56:16
Run the sector monthly and compare
the results.

00:00:56:16 - 00:00:57:24
If a hashtag that was niche

00:00:57:24 - 00:01:01:02
three months ago is now seeing rapid
growth in posts per day.

00:01:01:10 - 00:01:04:07
You might have spotted an emerging
trend early.

00:01:04:07 - 00:01:06:24
Getting in front of trending hashtag
before it peaks

00:01:06:24 - 00:01:10:02
is one of the most effective ways
to grow organically on Instagram.

00:01:10:21 - 00:01:13:23
And if you want to try a level deeper,
here's a fourth option for you.

00:01:14:09 - 00:01:16:05
You can always drill down
into the creators

00:01:16:05 - 00:01:19:17
behind the most popular or recent posts
that include your hashtag,

00:01:19:17 - 00:01:22:23
and start mapping the actual accounts
driving the conversation.
